# proxmox_node_capabilities (Data Source)

Lists capabilities of a node from `/nodes/{node}/capabilities`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_capabilities" "c" { node = "pve-1" }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Read-Only

- `capabilities` (List of String)
